material.description: OpenStax Physics §2.2 “Speed and Velocity”, subsection “Velocity”: average velocity is displacement divided by the elapsed time over which that displacement occurs. The same section distinguishes this vector quantity from scalar average speed, which is distance traveled divided by elapsed time. Supports the corrected Claim as average vector velocity only; it does not define scalar average speed by displacement/time. Section locator: https://openstax.org/books/physics/pages/2-2-speed-and-velocity
